name: portfolio-desk
title: Portfolio desk
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A mini portfolio desk that places the schedule, the dense table, the thread, and the in-place approval on one surface.

files.content:
"use client" /** * Clean-room portfolio desk. * It composes the schedule, the dense table, the thread, and the in-place approval. * Data stays in the props. The desk does not fetch. Spanish region names are the default. */ import * as React from "react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { ActivityChat, type ActivityChatProps } from "@/components/ui/activity-chat" import { DataTableReorder, type DataTableReorderProps, type DataTableReorderRow } from "@/components/ui/data-table-reorder" import { InlineApproveButton, type InlineApproveButtonProps } from "@/components/ui/inline-approve-button" import { TimelineGantt, type TimelineGanttProps } from "@/components/ui/timeline-gantt" export type PortfolioDeskLabels = { schedule: string ledger: string conversation: string approval: string } export const portfolioDeskLabels: PortfolioDeskLabels = { schedule: "Cronograma", ledger: "Tablero", conversation: "Conversación", approval: "Aprobación", } export const portfolioDeskLabelsEn: PortfolioDeskLabels = { schedule: "Schedule", ledger: "Ledger", conversation: "Conversation", approval: "Approval", } export type PortfolioDeskProps< TRow extends DataTableReorderRow, TTableMeta = Record, TGanttMeta = Record, TChatMeta = Record, > = { title: string subtitle?: string gantt: TimelineGanttProps table: DataTableReorderProps chat: ActivityChatProps approval?: InlineApproveButtonProps labels?: Partial className?: string } export function PortfolioDesk< TRow extends DataTableReorderRow, TTableMeta = Record, TGanttMeta = Record, TChatMeta = Record, >({ title, subtitle, gantt, table, chat, approval, labels, className, }: PortfolioDeskProps) { const copy = { ...portfolioDeskLabels, ...labels } const scheduleId = React.useId() const ledgerId = React.useId() const conversationId = React.useId() const approvalId = React.useId() return (

{title}

{subtitle ?

{subtitle}

: null}

{copy.schedule}

{...gantt} hideHeading className={cn("h-[26rem]", gantt.className)} />

{copy.conversation}

{...chat} className={cn("h-[26rem]", chat.className)} />

{copy.ledger}

{...table} />
{approval ? (

{copy.approval}

) : null}
) }

meta.usage:
<PortfolioDesk
  title="Taller Bruma"
  gantt={{ items, workstreams, now, onSelect }}
  table={{ rows, columns, onSortChange }}
  chat={{ messages, people, currentUserId, onSend, onPlay }}
  approval={{ onConfirm }}
/>

api.name: gantt / table / chat
api.description: Passed through. Each collection keeps its own meta type.

api.name: approval
api.description: Optional. Omit it to hide the approval row.

api.name: title / subtitle / labels
api.description: Spanish region names. portfolioDeskLabelsEn is the English set.

docs: Clean-room composition. The desk does not fetch and does not merge the three payloads: gantt meta, table meta, and chat meta stay separate. Pass the same props you would pass to each piece. Approval is optional. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has, or any of the four pieces when they are already installed. The item ships no theme. No mockup source, copy, colors, or assets were copied. The catalog demo is Taller Bruma, a fictional shop.
